calendar.title: Calendar [Français]
calendar.description: Track daily work, sweeps, and mileage with a visual weekly view [Français]

dashboard.title: Dashboard [Français]
dashboard.description: Quick adds for work, sweeps, and odometer readings. See payment breakdowns. [Français]

vanManagement.title: Van Management [Français]

settings.title: Settings [Français]

tour.title: Want to see how it works first? [Français]
tour.description: Take a quick guided tour of the dashboard to explore all features [Français]

dashboardQuickAddWork.title: Quick Add Work [Français]

dashboardPayment.title: Payment This Week [Français]

dashboardVanStatus.description: Track your van deposit progress and weekly costs. See how much you've paid and how much remains to reach £500. [Français]

calendarNavigation.title: Week Navigation [Français]

calendarWeekSummary.description: Full pay breakdown including base pay, 6-day bonus, sweeps, mileage, and van costs. Enter performance rankings here too. [Français]

calendarPaymentThisWeek.description: See what's hitting your bank account this week. Standard pay from 2 weeks ago plus performance bonus from 6 weeks ago. [Français]
